note: Real height fields come from tools/dev.sh dem (AWS Terrain Tiles, open data from USGS 3DEP and others); only their hillshade (sun 180,35) is kept here, the heights are regenerated with the command. Photos give the look; a photo's dimensions come from the dem of the same place. kind as in alpine/refs.json.

images.note: Book Cliffs front north of Price, Utah: a south-facing escarpment dissected into dendritic ridges and ravines (no sheer wall), over a pediment plain cut by inverted gravel channels. North is up.
Vermilion Cliffs near Pipe Spring, Arizona: a short vertical cap rock over a long straight debris slope strewn with fallen blocks, a mesa behind.
Seven Sisters, East Sussex: white chalk sea cliffs, flat vertical faces where rolling downs and their dry valleys are cut off by the sea, a shingle beach at the foot.

images.license: public domain (C. E. Watkins, 1870s; via USGS)
images.note: El Capitan, Yosemite: a smooth granite wall about 900 m high over a forested talus foot. Small stereo card in a frame: shapes only.
Na Pali coast, Kauai: steep vegetated sea cliffs with layered lava benches and fluted ridges; mostly hidden by trees in the foreground.
